user.title: Smart Charging
user.description: Select entities for price data, battery SOC and charger control.

params.title: Charging parameters
params.description: Set battery limits, daily consumption, the weekly 100 % boost and the currency of your price data. No price thresholds are needed - cheap hours are derived from the forecast.

data.min_soc: Minimum battery level (%), never plan below this
data.max_soc: Maximum battery level (%), normal charging target
data.daily_consumption_pct: Daily battery use (%), e.g. the daily commute
data.weekly_full_charge: Charge to 100 % about once a week (cheapest window)
data.deadline_time: Ready by (time, optional) - charging complete before this
data.deadline_restart_minutes: Restart after a passed deadline (minutes, 0 = never)
